Senses.Explanation: This deictic expression points back to a just-demonstrated action, wording, interpretation, or state: “in this way,” “like this,” or simply “so.” Huineng asks what is coming “in this way”; Shitou Xiqian blocks “this way,” “not this way,” and both together; Yuanwu Keqin warns that understanding in this way misses the matter, but elsewhere says that seeing in this way gives a share of freedom. The phrase also forms recurrent frames: “at precisely such a time” (正當恁麼時), “if so” (恁麼則), “must be this way” (直須恁麼), and Yuanwu Keqin’s self-reference to “talking this way” (恁麼說話). Foyan Qingyuan juxtaposes repeated “this way” with repeated “not this way,” while Sixin Wuxin says a great man is not made this way. Its translation therefore follows the demonstrative relation in each turn; the word does not itself name a teaching or a single approved manner.
Senses.Note: Exact frozen-corpus count: 32,601 hits in 432 files and 426 works. Ten curated occurrences cover affirmative, negative, conditional, temporal, consequential, required, and self-referential frames.

Occurrences.Kwic: 祖曰。什麼物恁麼來。曰說似一物即不中。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Record of the Transmission of the Lamp Published in the Jingde Era (景德傳燈錄): Huineng asks what comes in this way.

Occurrences.Kwic: 頭曰。恁麼也不得。不恁麼也不得。恁麼不恁麼總不得。子作麼生。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Compendium of the Five Lamps (五燈會元): Shitou Xiqian utters all affirmative and negative headword forms in one turn.
Blue Cliff Record by Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄): Yuanwu Keqin warns against understanding in this way.

Occurrences.Kwic: 且道。正當恁麼時如何。蟬聲時到耳。雁影忽迎眸。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuanwu Foguo (圓悟佛果禪師語錄): Yuanwu Keqin uses the temporal frame in his own address.

Occurrences.Kwic: 若恁麼見得。便有自由分。不隨一切語言轉。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record by Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄): Yuanwu Keqin utters the conditional seeing frame.

Occurrences.Kwic: 先德道恁麼恁麼又云不恁麼不恁麼
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Ancient Worthies (古尊宿語錄): Foyan Qingyuan utters the framing that contrasts repeated this-way and not-this-way sayings.

Occurrences.Kwic: 乃呵呵大笑云。山僧恁麼說話。大似無夢說夢無事生事。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuanwu Foguo (圓悟佛果禪師語錄): Yuanwu Keqin refers to his own talking this way.

Occurrences.Kwic: 所以道。以大圓覺為我伽藍。身心安居平等性智。恁麼則不可以方所為限。不可以時分為拘。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Extensive Record of Chan Master Hongzhi (宏智禪師廣錄): Hongzhi Zhengjue uses the consequential if-so frame.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師云。直須恁麼。師乃云。名不得象不得。從來清淨不受染污。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Extensive Record of Chan Master Hongzhi (宏智禪師廣錄): Hongzhi Zhengjue utters the required-action frame.

Occurrences.Kwic: 要做大漢，大漢不恁麼做；要做大漢麼，須是退步。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Sixin Wuxin (死心悟新禪師語錄（黃龍四家錄第三）): Sixin Wuxin denies that a great man is made this way.
